operatoren.definition: describe and explain in detail
beispiele: Analyse the way(s) in which atmosphere is created in the opening scene.

operatoren.definition: express a well-founded opinion on the nature or quality of sb./sth.
beispiele: Evaluate the success of the steps taken so far to reduce pollution as described in the text

operatoren.definition: describe and explain in detail
beispiele: Examine the opposing views on social class held by the two protagonists.

operatoren.definition: provide a thorough analysis of a character
beispiele: Give a characterization of the protagonist in the excerpt.

operatoren.definition: state one’s opinion clearly and support one’s view with evidence or reasons

operatoren.definition: show similarities and differences
beispiele: Compare the opinions on education held by the experts quoted in the text.

operatoren.definition: give a detailed account of what sb./sth. is like
beispiele: Describe the soldier’s situation as depicted in the text.

beispiele: Discuss the message of the cartoon, referring to work done on the British monarchy.

operatoren.definition: explain the meaning, purpose or message of sth.
beispiele: Interpret the sonnet, focusing on the way structure and imagery are used to express the speaker’s insight into the nature of time.

operatoren.definition: give the main features, structure or general principles of sth.
beispiele: Outline Panem’s history as presented in this excerpt.

operatoren.definition: find and explain certain aspects
beispiele: Point out the aspects that underline ...

operatoren.definition: present the main aspects of sth. briefly and clearly

operatoren.definition: give a concise account of the main points or ideas of a text, issue or topic
beispiele: Summarize/Sum up the information about green energy given in the text.

operatoren.definition: produce a text with specific features
beispiele: Write the ending of the story / a letter to the editor / a dialogue, etc. Write an interior monologue that reflects the character’s view of the situation and her / his feelings.

operatoren.definition: produce a text with specific features
